title: A Three-Window Decomposition of Cosmological Redshift in Energy-Flow Cosmology A synthesis note: TCMB , CDDR, and S(z) consistency under one regime parameter
description: Synthesis note introducing a single-integral decomposition of observed cosmological redshift in Energy-Flow Cosmology using an effective entropy field Seff and a unifying regime scale aG. It links three observational windows—TCMB(z), the cosmic distance-duality relation η(z), and structural S(z) consistency—under one parameter with explicit projections (aH0 = aG/2, ac = aG/4), and recovers ΛCDM when ∇Seff → 0.

redshift_integral.description: Path-dependent decomposition of observed redshift along a null geodesic in terms of the effective entropy field and its directional derivative.

Seff_projection.description: Definition of the regime-dependent projection operator combining flow and latent entropy fields via screening parameter ξ.

Seff_first_order.description: First-order approximation to Seff valid when ξ varies slowly along the photon path.

core_lock_ceff.description: Core Lock relation linking the effective propagation speed to the entropy potential with ac projected from the single scale aG; feeds CDDR deviations.

LCDM_limit.description: In the absence of Seff gradients, the framework reduces exactly to the standard ΛCDM redshift relation.

key_results.main_finding: Provides a unified line-integral redshift decomposition tied to a single regime scale aG that simultaneously constrains three observational windows and predicts CDDR deviations |η(z)−1| ~ 10^-3–10^-2 (up to ~5×10^-2 in saturation), while reducing to ΛCDM when ∇Seff → 0.

sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Joint RSD + weak lensing EG measurements across 0 < z ≲ 1.

sealed_predictions.statement: Gravitational slip in Bullet-like clusters: η = Φ/Ψ = 0.9993 (sealed prediction, KILL-tagged).
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Combined lensing and dynamical mass reconstructions in merging clusters.

sealed_predictions.statement: Modified-gravity response quadrant: μ < 1 and Σ > 1 (sealed prediction, KILL-tagged).
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Global fits to growth-rate (RSD) and weak-lensing convergence (WL) mapping the μ–Σ plane.

sealed_predictions.statement: ϕ–ψ gravitational slip transition redshift z = 0.44 (sealed prediction, KILL-tagged).
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Tomographic reconstructions of metric potentials from WL+RSD/ISW-lensing cross-correlations.

sealed_predictions.statement: Low-redshift clustering amplitude σ8 = 0.43 (sealed prediction, DAMAGE-tagged).
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Galaxy clustering and weak-lensing constraints on σ8 at z ≲ 0.5.

kill_criteria: KC1: MB-independent CDDR tests find |η(z) − 1| < 3×10^-4 (95% CL) for 0 < z ≤ 3 with no positive trend, excluding the predicted 10^-3–10^-2 deviations implied by ac = aG/4.
KC2: High-precision TCMB(z) measurements confirm T(z) = T0(1+z) with fractional deviations < 3×10^-4 up to z ≳ 3, leaving no room for the required ∂S F contributions in the thermal window.
KC3: A single aG fails to map consistently across windows: best-fit parameters violate aH0 = aG/2 and ac = aG/4 by > 3σ when inferred separately from background expansion and CDDR.
KC4: Any sealed perturbation-sector prediction listed (EG=1.086, η=0.9993, μ<1 & Σ>1, z_slip=0.44, or σ8=0.43) is rejected at > 3σ by robust joint analyses.

KC5: Targeted line-of-sight comparisons show redshift is purely metric-only (no path dependence) at the ≤10^-3 level across diverse environments after controlling for lensing/magnification, contradicting Eq. (1).
KC6: Structural S(z) consistency fails: JWST-era early-structure timelines and CMB-inferred growth cannot be reconciled under any single-parameter Seff projection Pξ at > 3σ.
